name: notion
description:
Connect Notion to your agent so it works from the same context as your team and other agents. Connect Notion to your agent so it works from the same context as your team and other agents. Search your workspace, create and update pages, manage projects and tasks, and save your work back to Notion.

- **Find answers in your workspace:** Search your pages and databases for answers grounded in your team’s knowledge.
- **Turn chats into docs:** Save research, plans, specs, and notes as pages your team can review and edit.
- **Keep projects moving:** Create tasks, update statuses, and add notes to your databases directly from chat.
- **Share one brain across agents:** Store memories and skills in Notion so your agents follow your preferences and ways of working.

capabilities: Plan your day and manage your calendar
Find time to meet with coworkers
Prepare meetings and capture next steps
Draft PRDs and turn specs into tasks
Write project updates and keep plans current
Plan marketing campaigns and content calendars
Delegate work to Notion Custom Agents
Build a CRM for contacts, accounts, and deals
Prepare sales calls and account briefs
